definitions.explanation: The degree to which two people, things, or elements go well together. Can refer to interpersonal chemistry, food pairings, or how well software or hardware works together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相性|あいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: The two of them are compatible.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦チーズ→チーズ：00026_chiizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{相性|あいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧だ。
examples.english: Wine and cheese go perfectly together.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ソフトウェア→ソフトウェア：04719_sofutowea⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦パソコン→パソコン：01538_pasokon⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相性|あいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧、⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦フリーズ→フリーズ：11172_furiizu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This software has poor compatibility with old computers and freezes often.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good compatibility) or ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (poor compatibility). Also common with ⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧ (outstanding) and ⟦{最悪|さいあく}→最悪：13009_saiaku⟧ (worst). Used broadly — for people, food pairings, technology, and more.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {相性|あいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: compatible, go well together
- {相性|あいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: incompatible
- {相性|あいしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧: perfectly suited
- {相性|あいしょう}⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧: compatibility test
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{相性|あいしょう}: compatibility with ~

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{愛称|あいしょう}→愛称：12678_aishou⟧: nickname, pet name (different meaning)
